Below I’ll treat you as a fact‑checking client: every concrete claim is backed by a URL, and I’ll distinguish **first‑party/vendor** sources from **third‑party/user‑report** sources. When something isn’t documented I will say **“not found”** rather than infer.

---

## 1) Major AI music generators: API / capabilities / licensing (as of 2025–2026)

### ElevenLabs Music (“Eleven Music API”)

**API / programmatic access**

- ElevenLabs has an **official Music API** exposed as part of ElevenAPI, available to paid users.[Vendor: ElevenLabs docs]  
  https://elevenlabs.io/docs/changelog/2025/8/20  
  https://elevenlabs.io/eleven-music-api  
  https://elevenlabs.io/music  
  https://x.com/ElevenLabs/status/1957489735527502301  

**Max clip length**

- Vendor docs state `music_length_ms` controls duration from **3 seconds to 10 minutes (600,000 ms)** per track.[Vendor]  
  https://elevenlabs.io/eleven-music-api  

**Stems / separate instruments**

- Public docs describe generation of “tracks,” and “sections” within a composition, but do **not** document per‑instrument or per‑stem audio exports; only whole mixed tracks are described.[Vendor]  
  https://elevenlabs.io/eleven-music-api  

→ **Stems: not found** in public docs.

**Audio‑to‑audio / continuation / style reference**

- Public marketing and docs describe **text‑prompt composition** (“create music from text prompts”) and configuration of length, structure, and language.[Vendor]  
  https://elevenlabs.io/docs/changelog/2025/8/20  
  https://x.com/ElevenLabs/status/1957489735527502301  

- No public endpoint description for uploading an audio reference for style‑matching or continuation.

→ **Audio‑to‑audio / reference: not found** in current public docs.

**Commercial use**

- ElevenLabs explicitly states: “Songs are **available for broad commercial use on all paid plans**. Film, TV, and large studio game rights require an Enterprise plan.”[Vendor]  
  https://elevenlabs.io/eleven-music-api  
  https://elevenlabs.io/music  

---

### Suno

**API / programmatic access**

- As of 2025–2026, Suno publicly advertises consumer‑facing apps and web UI; a **public, documented API for programmatic music generation is not described** on official help/docs. (Their site focuses on app integrations and partnerships, not developer API documentation.)[Vendor overview]  
  https://www.suno.ai  

→ **Official public API: not found**. Some third‑party libraries exist but they are reverse‑engineered; no official developer doc.

**Max clip length / stems / audio‑to‑audio**

- Public docs emphasize track creation via the app (e.g., ~1–2 minute songs historically), but current **official maximum duration, stem export, or audio‑to‑audio features are not formally documented** in a technical API spec accessible to developers.[Vendor overview]  
  https://www.suno.ai  

→ **Max length / stems / reference‑track upload: not found** in first‑party technical documentation.

**Commercial use**

- Multiple industry trackers note that **Suno allows commercial use of outputs by paid subscribers**, subject to its Terms of Use, but the precise legal language is in Suno’s Terms, which are not mirrored in the search snippets we have.[Third‑party]  
  https://dynamoi.com/learn/ai-music-distribution/ai-music-copyright-cases-timeline  

You should check the current **Suno Terms of Service / Commercial Use FAQ** directly; I cannot quote the exact clause here because it was not present in the snippets.

**Lawsuits / settlements**

- Warner Music Group settled its copyright case with Suno in **November 2025**, forming a **licensing partnership**.[Third‑party: Reuters, Bloomberg, industry trackers]  
  https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/universal-music-settles-copyright-dispute-with-ai-firm-udio-2025-10-30/  
  https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-11-25/warner-music-settles-lawsuit-with-ai-music-startup-suno  
  https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjdrl7lr039o  
  https://www.musicbusinessworldwide.com/musicians-union-sues-umg-and-warner-music-alleging-member-recordings-were-licensed-to-suno-and-udio-without-compensation-or-credit/  
  https://www.aimusic.events/news/umg-suno-udio-lawsuits-actual-state  
  https://www.chartlex.com/blog/business/music-industry-ai-lawsuits-tracker-2026  
  https://dynamoi.com/learn/ai-music-distribution/ai-music-copyright-cases-timeline  
  https://finance.yahoo.com/sectors/technology/articles/umg-sony-music-entertainment-requesting-170045934.html  

- According to updated lawsuit trackers, **Warner settled with Suno**, but **Universal (UMG) and Sony continue to litigate** against Suno as of mid‑2026.[Third‑party]  
  https://www.chartlex.com/blog/business/music-industry-ai-lawsuits-tracker-2026  
  https://ailawsuittracker.com/cases/umg-v-suno/  
  https://www.aimusic.events/news/warner-is-out-sony-is-in-the-actual-state-of-the-ai  

So: Warner is now a licensing partner; UMG/Sony still have open actions.

---

### Udio

**API / programmatic access**

- Udio’s public site is consumer‑oriented; there is **no public, fully documented developer API** described in search results.[Vendor overview]  
  https://www.udio.com  

→ **Official public API: not found**.

**Max clip length / stems / audio‑to‑audio**

- No first‑party developer reference specifying maximum length, stem output, or audio‑to‑audio in an API context is visible.  
→ **Max length / stems / audio‑to‑audio capabilities: not found** in vendor docs.

**Commercial use**

- Industry legal coverage indicates Udio continues to operate as a **consumer platform whose outputs can be used commercially** subject to its terms, and that its licensing settlements have strengthened its legal position.[Third‑party]  
  https://dynamoi.com/learn/ai-music-distribution/ai-music-copyright-cases-timeline  
  https://www.chartlex.com/blog/business/music-industry-ai-lawsuits-tracker-2026  

For exact commercial license, you’d need to read Udio’s Terms directly (not fully visible here).

**Lawsuits / settlements**

- Universal Music Group settled with Udio in **October 2025**, announcing a “compensatory legal settlement” plus **license agreements** and a joint platform planned for 2026.[Third‑party]  
  https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/universal-music-settles-copyright-dispute-with-ai-firm-udio-2025-10-30/  
  https://www.musicbusinessworldwide.com/musicians-union-sues-umg-and-warner-music-alleging-member-recordings-were-licensed-to-suno-and-udio-without-compensation-or-credit/  
  https://www.chartlex.com/blog/business/music-industry-ai-lawsuits-tracker-2026  
  https://dynamoi.com/learn/ai-music-distribution/ai-music-copyright-cases-timeline  

- Warner Music also settled with Udio around **November 2025**.[Third‑party]  
  https://www.chartlex.com/blog/business/music-industry-ai-lawsuits-tracker-2026  
  https://ailawsuittracker.com/cases/umg-v-suno/  
  https://finance.yahoo.com/sectors/technology/articles/umg-sony-music-entertainment-requesting-170045934.html  

- Trackers note that **Sony continues litigating Udio alone as of mid‑2026**, and even filed a second suit in July 2026, while UMG and Warner have dismissed their claims after settling.[Third‑party]  
  https://www.chartlex.com/blog/business/music-industry-ai-lawsuits-tracker-2026  
  https://ailawsuittracker.com/cases/umg-v-suno/  

---

### Stable Audio (proprietary) vs Stable Audio Open

There are **two different things**:

1. **Stable Audio** – proprietary service/API by Stability AI.
2. **Stable Audio Open / Stable Audio Open Small** – **open‑weight** models.

#### Stable Audio (cloud service)

**API / programmatic access**

- Stability AI historically offered a Stable Audio API, but the **current 2025–26 API reference for the proprietary Stable Audio service was not in the retrieved snippets.**  
→ **Up‑to‑date API docs (max length, stems, etc.) for proprietary Stable Audio: not found** in the search snippets.

Given that, I can only give verified facts for **Stable Audio Open**, which is open‑weight.

---

#### Stable Audio Open (open‑weight models)

**Model + max clip length**

- Stable Audio Open 1.0 is an **open‑weight generative audio model** by Stability AI; the official card says it generates **stereo audio up to 47 seconds at 44.1 kHz** from text prompts.[Vendor]  
  https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stable-audio-open-1.0
